speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: Beyond security and convenience, our larger goals include enhancing the efficiency of our enterprises and business processes.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: A fully functioning national identity system and e-payment platform will enable the delivery of more innovative services to a wider client base at lower cost.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: For example, there would be less need for counter services and the processing of paper forms.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: The National Digital Identity (NDI) will create opportunities for new business models.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: To realise these outcomes, we need the public and private sectors to collaborate and to develop the appropriate industry standards.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: We have started consultations with several industry sectors, and plan to conduct trials for value-added services with the participation of companies.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: We are particularly interested in form factors that make it convenient for the elderly, the young and the disabled to use and benefit from NDI.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: A Smart Nation must serve all segments of the population.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: So, whatever solutions and processes that are in place, it will be a gradual phased transition.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: For any given platform, service, product or process, there is likely to be a transition phase where there will be multiple pathways.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: You should be able to use various ways to authenticate and verify identity.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: You will have that parallel process for some time.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: So, it will be a very phased transition.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: This will also allow us to make sure that whatever new solutions we put in place are robust, user-friendly, effective and we would be able to update the technology over time.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: It also requires us to put in place some discipline about how we design our solutions to make sure there is significant interoperability among the standards.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: This feeds into the second question that Ms Tin asked.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: We want that interoperability to extend into the private sector as far as possible.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: Private sector players would, of course, have to then comply with the various regulations that we impose.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: The banks are private sector players and they are riding on PayNow.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: So, we do expect and hope that more and more of our Smart Nation platforms will extend out from the public sector to the private sector.
